assumptions: `chalupa` was searched as a house-like input type but no retained row needed separate normalization.
Land rows were kept only when the listing explicitly indicated buildable or residential use.
Single-agent fallback was used portal-by-portal without sub-agents, per the skill instructions.
gaps: `reality.idnes.cz`: no credible municipality-specific sale detail hit was surfaced for České Meziříčí under the required filters.
`mmreality.cz`: surfaced municipality matches were excluded because the active house listing had only 892 m2 of land and the surfaced MM link for the Záhumenská land listing was explicitly inactive.

`reality.aktualne.cz`: municipality matches were visible on search-result pages, but the surfaced snippets did not expose parcel area or a usable detail page needed to verify the 1000 m2 land minimum, so no row was retained.
`realitymix.cz`: excluded additional rows for being `Rezervováno`, below the 1000 m2 land minimum, or not explicitly buildable/residential (`zahrada`).
For the retained house on Na Nábřeží, the land area was corroborated from a same-listing mirror excerpt while keeping the original RealityMix detail URL in the output.
